title: David and Jonathan
summary: In David and Jonathan, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. David and Jonathan showed loyal friendship in a dangerous time.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Samuel 20:12-17 and underline the part that best shows friendship.

tell_it: David and Jonathan showed loyal friendship in a dangerous time. Jonathan loved David as a friend and helped protect him. Their friendship showed loyalty and courage. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. David and Jonathan gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: David and Jonathan showed loyal friendship in a dangerous time.
age_8_11_explanation: Jonathan loved David as a friend and helped protect him. Their friendship showed loyalty and courage. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: True friendship is loyal, truthful, and willing to protect another person.
David and Jonathan shows friendship through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When friendship costs something, this story shows that real loyalty protects instead of using people.
life_application: When friendship costs something, this story shows that real loyalty protects instead of using people.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps David and Jonathan connected to the actual passage?
quiz_questions.explanation: Jonathan is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: David and Jonathan is mainly about friendship without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of 1 Samuel 20:12-17, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: 1 Samuel 20:17 gives this lesson a short Scripture anchor to remember.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in David and Jonathan?
What truth should a kid remember after reading David and Jonathan?
How can the group pray about David and Jonathan without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Friendship Shield
activity.instructions: Design a shield with words like honesty, protection, and loyalty.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use David and Jonathan to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading David and Jonathan.
